name: Diablo Resources Limited
summary: Diablo Resources Limited, established in 2021 and headquartered in West Perth, acquires and explores mineral properties in the United States. It owns 100% of the Devils Canyon Project on Nevada's Carlin trend, about 6.56 square kilometers over 90 claims, and manages the Western Desert Project north of Wendover, Utah, covering about 25 square kilometers through 258 claims and a state lease.
